title: AI output is non-authoritative and cannot autonomously purge media
statement: AI may create provenance-preserving suggestions or action proposals, but it cannot directly mutate canonical media or autonomously perform permanent deletion.
rationale: Typed, reviewable output and a separate human-confirmed trash and purge sequence preserve authorization, auditability, and recovery.

anchors.locator: An AI provider may write typed suggestions or an `ActionProposal`. It receives no interface capable of deleting, moving, hiding, banning, reporting, or writing arbitrary storage objects.
No model score can bypass these stages.

evidence.locator: | Deletion invariant | No model output can directly mutate or permanently delete media |
- Autonomous moderation, deletion, purge, or account restriction.
